text_blocks.snippet: Many states in the US have laws requiring or encouraging the fluoridation of public water systems. Some states with prominent fluoridation mandates include California, Delaware, Georgia, Illinois, Kentucky, Louisiana, Minnesota, Mississippi, Nebraska, Nevada, Ohio, and South Dakota, according to Stateline.org. Other states with high rates of fluoridated water, though not necessarily through mandates, include Kentucky, Minnesota, Illinois, North Dakota, and Georgia, according to Newsweek.
